A few useful answers

Good questions
are welcome.

Still curious? Talk to us
Do I need equipment?

We send a simple home exercise kit with the programme. Every movement also has chair, wall or no-equipment options.

How often will I exercise?

Most members follow three 15–25 minute sessions each week, with gentle daily movement encouraged between sessions.

Can I join if I have more than one problem area?

Yes. Start with the area that limits you most today. Your plan can expand as your confidence and capacity grow.

Is this a replacement for seeing a physiotherapist?

No. Online guidance supports your care, but it does not replace an individual clinical assessment. We will guide you to the right next step.
